title: Pakistan's first astronaut reaches China's Tiangong space station on Shenzhou-24
caption:
China's Shenzhou-24 spacecraft has docked with the Tiangong space station, carrying Pakistani air force pilot Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, the first foreign crew member to visit the station. He flew with Chinese astronauts Tang Hongbo and Wu Yi from the Jiuquan launch centre. The crew plans about 90 experiments, and Pakistan's space agency says it aims to reach the moon by 2035.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
